sources.title: Kataguru-Sceptic-35B-A3B-Estonian-v3.2 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: RELEASE STATUS: IN TRAINING QUEUE — Release ETA < 1 Month This repository is an official pre-release slot in the Kataguru Sovereign Language Editions (254 + 2 MoE) queue. Weights (NVFP4-W4ATTN-AWQ Hybrid, AWQ W4A16, and GGUF APEX-Trio + mmproj-f16) will be uploaded within < 1 month immediately after full dataset spot-check certification and 15-benchmark + native Estonian evaluation.

sources.title: Kataguru-Sceptic-35B-A3B-v2.6-NVFP4 - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Kataguru-Sceptic-35B-A3B-v2.6-NVFP4 is a bilingual (English & Finnish) 35-billion parameter (3B active parameters per token, 254 routed experts per layer) multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model quantized to NVIDIA Blackwell NVFP4 (compressed-tensors) with synchronized w13 (gate_proj + up_proj) weight_global_scale across all 10,160 routed experts.
